info.title: Get FBT Inbound Order Details
info.description: This API is used to retrieve the inbound order details including the planned inbound detail, actual inbound detail and inbound status, etc.

get.description: This API is used to retrieve the inbound order details including the planned inbound detail, actual inbound detail and inbound status, etc.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: order_ids
parameters.description:
The list of numeric identifiers of the inbound orders to fetch information for.  
**Note:** Provide the numeric sequence only; do not include the "IBR" prefix (e.g., use `123456` instead of `IBR123456`). There is a **limit of 10 orders** to be fetched in each request.

You can get the value in `data.inbound_order_id` in [Inbound FBT order status change](6708f866a88d1103246fed6a) webhook or in `data.inventory_records.order.id` in the response of [Search FBT Inventory Record](670d584ba83c5f030f3071e4).

parameters.name: include_carton_details
parameters.description:
A boolean flag that determines whether the response should include granular information for each individual carton within the shipment.

**Note**: When set to `true`, the response will include the `carton_details` field. If set to `false` or omitted, this field will be excluded from the response payload to optimize performance.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

order_id.description: The numeric identifier for inbound order in Fulfilled by TikTok system.

order_id_string.description: The string identifier for inbound order in Fulfilled by TikTok system.

order_plan_id.description: Plan identifier for the inbound order.

id.description: The identifier of the merchant in Fulfilled by TikTok system.

name.description: Name of the Fulfilled by TikTok merchant.

merchant.description: Information regarding the merchant who owns the order.

create_time.description: Unix seconds timestamp when the inbound order was created.

ship_time.description: Unix seconds timestamp when the inbound order was shipped.

expected_arrival_time.description: Unix seconds timestamp of the expected arrival time provided by merchant.

actual_arrival_time.description: Unix seconds timestamp of the actual arrival time of the inbound order.

fbt_warehouse_id.description: The identifier for warehouse generated by Fulfilled by TikTok system.

business_warehouse_ids.description: The business identifier for warehouse generated by TikTok Shop system, correlated with the `fbt_warehouse_id`.

name.description: The Fulfilled by TikTok warehouse name.

type.description:
Type of warehouse associated with the inbound order.

Possible values:
* `HUB`
* `FC` (Fulfillment Center)

operate_time.description: The time when the inbound order is processed by the merchant or warehouses, represented as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

new_status.description:
The order status in **Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT)** warehouse after this operation.

**Possible values:**
* `WORKING`
* `READY_TO_SHIP`
* `TO_BE_RECEIVED`
* `ARRIVED_HUB`
* `INTERNAL_TRANSFER`
* `RECEIVING`
* `PARTIALLY_RECEIVED`
* `RECEIVED`
* `CANCELLED`
* `DELIVERED`

previous_status.description:
The order status in **Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT)** warehouse before this operation.

**Possible values:**
* `WORKING`
* `READY_TO_SHIP`
* `TO_BE_RECEIVED`
* `ARRIVED_HUB`
* `INTERNAL_TRANSFER`
* `RECEIVING`
* `PARTIALLY_RECEIVED`
* `RECEIVED`
* `CANCELLED`
* `DELIVERED`

operator.description: The unique identifier or name of the user or system entity that performed the status change.

status_logs.description: A list of inbound order operation history.

provider_name.description:
Name of the logistics service provider

Possible values:
* `FEDEX` (Federal Express)
* `UPS` (United Parcel Service)
* `DHL` (DHL Express)
* `USPS` (United States Postal Service)
* `OTHER` (All other logistics providers)

waybill_number.description: The tracking number for the current inbound shipment with the carrier.

related_number.description: Carton number tied to the logistics information.

logistic_info_list.description: List of logistics information tied to the order. Only populated for small-parcel inbound orders.

carton_type.description:
Whether this carton is single-SKU or multi-SKU.

**Possible values:**
* `SINGLE_SKU`
* `MULTI_SKU`

weight_unit.description:
The unit of measurement used for the weight of the items or cartons in this shipment.

**Possible values:**
* `KILOGRAM` (kg)
* `GRAM` (g)
* `MILLIGRAM` (mg)
* `POUNDS` (lbs)
* `OUNCE` (oz)

length_unit.description:
The unit of measurement used for the dimensions (length, width, height) of the items or cartons in this shipment.

**Possible values:**
* `METER` (m)
* `CENTIMETER` (cm)
* `MILLIMETER` (mm)
* `FOOT` (ft)
* `MICRON` (μm)
* `INCH` (in)

goods_id.description: Identifier for goods within the Fulfilled by TikTok system.

quantity.description: Quantity of this goods lot in th ecarton.

items.description: List of items in this carton.

carton_details.description: Detailed carton information for the inbound order. Only populated if `include_carton_details` is passed as true in the request.

goods_id.description: The unique numeric identifier of the goods within Fulfilled by TikTok.

lot_code.description: The specific batch or lot number assigned by the manufacturer for this group of items.

expiration_time.description: The expiration date of the items in this lot, provided as a Unix timestamp in **seconds**.

planned_count.description: The total quantity of this specific lot expected to be received as part of the inbound order.

normal_received_count.description: The quantity of items received at **fulfillment centers** in sellable (good) condition for this lot. If the inbound order is sent to a hub, this value will only be updated when the goods are subsequently transferred to the fulfillment center.

defective_received_count.description: The quantity of items received in a damaged or unsellable state.

inbound_goods_lot_receive_item_details.description: A detailed breakdown of planned versus actual receiving information, segmented by item, lot number, and expiration date.

inbound_orders.description: A list of inbound order detail information.
